# Plan — 2026-10-05

## Research Summary

Based on the 2026-10-05 research brief, we have **1 NEW actionable item** (HIGH priority production bug) plus **7 carry-forward items** from previous research. The top priority is a silent skill/agent/command loss bug caused by gray-matter cache poisoning after YAML parse errors in multi-worktree setups.

## Current Backlog Status

- Open auto-implement issues: 2 (#1926 MCP CIMD, #1927 session retention)
- Maximum new issues to create: 5
- Cumulative backlog: ~47-71h (7 carry-forward items + 1 NEW)

## Top 5 Prioritized Items for Implementation

### 1. **Skill cache bypass** (NEW 2026-10-05, HIGH priority)
- **Size**: SMALL ~1-2h
- **Category**: tool
- **Priority**: HIGH - Production bug causing silent skill/agent/command loss
- **What**: Pass `{ cache: null }` to gray-matter calls in skill/agent/command loaders
- **Why**: Malformed YAML in one skill/agent/command poisons cache, all subsequent parses with identical content silently fail
- **Files to modify**:
  - `src/skill/index.ts` L133
  - `src/agent/customAgentLoader.ts` L103
  - `src/command/index.ts` L334
  - Add unit test in `tests/skill/` or `src/skill/` for malformed YAML → valid skill sequence

### 2. **Oversized tool result caching** (carry-forward from 2026-10-01)
- **Size**: MEDIUM ~8-12h
- **Category**: tool
- **Priority**: MEDIUM - Session memory optimization
- **What**: Implement session memory cache with recovery URIs for MCP/external tool results
- **Why**: Large tool outputs (file reads, web fetches) exhaust context window
- **Files to modify**:
  - `src/core/orchestrator.ts` or `src/core/streamingOrchestrator.ts` (cache layer)
  - `src/tool/registry.ts` (result size detection)
  - `src/session/sessionManager.ts` (iteration eviction, 16 MiB LRU)
  - Add tests in `tests/core/` for cache hit/miss, eviction

### 3. **Goal command prompt cache preservation** (carry-forward from 2026-09-30)
- **Size**: MEDIUM ~4-6h
- **Category**: tool
- **Priority**: MEDIUM - Performance optimization for long-running goals
- **What**: Cache tool schemas at goal start, pass frozen schemas through goal loop
- **Why**: Re-building tool schemas on every goal iteration breaks prompt caching
- **Files to modify**:
  - `src/core/orchestrator.ts` (goal loop schema caching)
  - `src/tool/registry.ts` (schema serialization)
  - Add tests in `tests/core/` for schema freeze/reuse

### 4. **TUI subagent steering** (carry-forward from 2026-10-03)
- **Size**: MEDIUM ~4-6h
- **Category**: tool
- **Priority**: MEDIUM - TUI user experience enhancement
- **What**: Mount prompt in subagent view, visual treatment, board notification, key hierarchy
- **Why**: Users need visibility and control over subagent execution
- **Files to modify**:
  - `src/cli/tui/*.tsx` (subagent view components)
  - `src/core/orchestrator.ts` (board notification hooks)
  - Add tests in `src/cli/tui/*.test.tsx` for rendering

### 5. **Prompt draft persistence wiring** (carry-forward from 2026-10-02)
- **Size**: SMALL ~2-3h
- **Category**: tool
- **Priority**: MEDIUM - TUI user experience
- **What**: TUI session switch handler, wire `DraftCache` save/restore
- **Why**: Users lose unsent prompts when switching sessions
- **Files to modify**:
  - `src/cli/tui/interactive.tsx` or `src/cli/interactive.ts` (session switch handler)
  - `src/session/sessionManager.ts` (draft cache integration)
  - Add tests in `tests/session/` for draft persistence
